briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI accelerate supercluster deployments amid intensifying AGI race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier continues rapid expansion with major labs unveiling next-generation systems and infrastructure. Geopolitical tensions and safety concerns are rising in parallel with capability gains. Funding remains robust despite regulatory scrutiny.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's o4 model family shows gains in reasoning benchmarks while Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus. xAI deploys Grok-3 on expanded Memphis cluster and DeepSeek unveils V3.5 with improved multilingual performance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and edge deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100-equivalent clusters in Texas and Nevada. TSMC reports sustained demand for advanced AI accelerators through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a coalition including Chinese entities by 2028?
